licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), page 85, bars 1–7 of the recitative before No. 10a
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker (clean). The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: a single bass staff is printed for the keyboard, written here as the piano's left hand. It ends "attacca" into No. 10a. Playback tempo: free, as recitative is sung, played at a speaking pace, ♩ = 70, about 24 seconds, from the median of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958, Giulini 1959, Böhm 1977, Haitink 1984, Karajan 1985: 0:26, 0:17, 0:24, 0:30, 0:19; median 0:24).
